summary_md: **Nick Spitsyn ([@nick_spiz](https://x.com/nick_spiz/status/2115707868737622496))** shares **inbox-to-brain**, which gives Claude Code a single inbox folder for notes plus two small scripts that file each note in the right place and flag junk, keeping agent memory as plain text without a database ([nickspiz/inbox-to-brain](https://github.com/nickspiz/inbox-to-brain)).
